english.title: Cause or permit obstruction to entrance, exit or gangway of public service vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused or permitted an unnecessary obstruction to

(A)_[an entrance]_
(B)_[an exit]_
(C)_[a gangway]_

of a public service vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), while passengers were being carried by the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 37 of the Public Service Vehicles (Conditions of Fitness, Equipment, Use and Certification) Regulations 1981 and section 67 of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
